sched_profile_note: New schedules are made in %1$s. To make one in another profile, switch the profile in the menu.
sched_form_no_agents: No agent in this profile can take a prompt.
sched_form_prompt: What should the agent be asked?
sched_opt_missed_hint: If the hub was not running at its time, it runs once when the hub is back within 24 hours. Off, it never runs late, and the history says so.
sched_opt_overlap: If the previous run is still going
sched_opt_overlap_hint: “Run now” always starts at once and stops nothing.
sched_opt_skip_hint: This time does not run, and the history says so.
sched_opt_wait_hint: Runs as soon as the previous run ends. Only one time waits.
sched_opt_parallel_hint: Runs in a new conversation next to the previous one.
sched_opt_replace_hint: Stops the previous run, then starts.
sched_opt_hermes: Hermes decides these two for its own jobs, so they are not set here.
sched_hermes_unreachable: Hermes is not answering right now, so nothing was changed.
sched_hermes_timezone: Hermes runs every cron in %1$s. Use that zone, or change Hermes's timezone.
sched_hermes_delivery: Hermes posts to messaging platforms itself — ask for it in the prompt.
sched_hermes_prompt_required: A schedule for Hermes needs a prompt.
sched_hermes_fired: Hermes will run it on its next tick.
sched_hermes_run_options: Hermes decides the run options for its own jobs, so they are not set here.
sched_run_waiting: Waiting for the previous run to end
sched_jobs_note: What runs on its own for this agent in this profile. For Hermes these are the jobs in its own scheduler. Make one with New job, or change one with Edit.
sched_jobs_none_body: Nothing is scheduled for this agent in this profile. Make a schedule on the Schedules page and it shows here.
sched_jobs_delete_body: It is deleted from Hermes's scheduler too.
